The '''BactaMax medical center''' was a medical facility that operated on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] dockmaster [[Lanni]] was taken to the center for treatment after she was badly burned in an attack on the [[Greentop Tower]] freight facility by agents of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Noako]].
